description: Fetch the full record for one CPSC recall by recall number: hazard description, remedy instructions, every product variant, UPCs, incident and injury reports, images, and the official CPSC recall page URL. Get a recall number from cpsc_search_recalls or cpsc_get_recent. CPSC jurisdiction: consumer products only — food/drugs (FDA), motor vehicles/tires (NHTSA), boats (USCG), pesticides (EPA), and firearms (ATF) are covered by other agencies.

recall_number.description: CPSC recall number: 5 digits for 2002–present records, e.g. "25043", or 5 digits plus a letter a–d for 1998–2001 records, e.g. "99003a". Get one from cpsc_search_recalls or cpsc_get_recent results.

name: cpsc_get_recall

consumer_contact.description: Contact information for claiming the remedy. Null when not provided.

coordinated_recalls.description: URLs of coordinated recalls by other agencies (e.g., Canada Health).

items.description: URL of coordinated recall by another agency.

cpsc_jurisdiction.description: Which products CPSC covers and which agencies cover the rest — food/drugs (FDA), motor vehicles/tires (NHTSA), boats (USCG), pesticides (EPA), firearms (ATF).

cpsc_url.description: Official CPSC recall page — authoritative source for consumers.

data_quality_notes.description: Gaps this server observed in the CPSC record — absent description, absent hazard text, absent product entries. Derived from which fields CPSC left empty, not from any judgement about the recall itself. Empty when nothing is missing.

items.description: One gap found in the CPSC record.

description.description: Full recall description including product identification details. Model numbers are typically embedded here, not in a structured field. Null when CPSC published the record without a description — rare, but a genuine record can still be complete otherwise.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No recall exists with the given recall number. `upstream_error`: The CPSC recall service (saferproducts.gov) was unavailable, timed out, reported a temporary failure reading its recall data, or sent an unreadable response. `upstream_rejected`: CPSC rejected the lookup instead of returning a recall, and it rejects the same request every time. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: A hazard associated with this recall.

description.description: What is dangerous about this product.

images.description: Product and identification images from the recall notice.

items.description: An image from the recall notice.

caption.description: Caption describing what the image shows.

injuries.description: Injury and incident report narrative, e.g. "None reported" or incident count.

products.description: Products covered. A recall may include multiple products. Model numbers are often in the description text, not a structured field.

items.description: A product covered by this recall.

units_recalled.description: Estimated number of units recalled, e.g. "About 2,500".

remedy_instructions.description: Full remedy instructions — exactly what a consumer should do and how to claim.

remedy_options.description: Remedy types available: Refund, Repair, Replace, New Instructions, Dispose, Label, No Remedy Available, Inspect. Often empty — CPSC classified the remedy on fewer than half its records. Read remedy_instructions when this is empty, and fall back to cpsc_url when that is empty too, rather than reporting that no remedy exists.

retailers.description: Retailer names with sale date ranges and price.

items.description: Retailer name with sale date range and price.

source_note.description: Provenance caveat: recall fields are CPSC record text with HTML markup and character codes converted to plain text, not otherwise edited or verified; check cpsc_url before a consumer-facing decision.

upcs.description: UPC codes for this recall (sparse — ~4% of records have UPCs). CPSC lists UPCs for the recall as a whole, not per product, so on a recall covering several products a UPC cannot be tied to one of them.

title: Get CPSC Recall Detail
